en.title: What's new in 0.14.1
highlights: Settings no longer jump-scroll while editing
Lighter new-assistant overlay in light theme
Clearer tool names: Notes, Search chat history
en.bodyMarkdown:
## Fixed

- Settings: SlidingPillTabs no longer call scrollIntoView (stops outer settings pane snap-back while typing/autosaving); settings body/nav use the same thin scroll-fade scrollbar treatment as chat.
- Settings: Watchdog fields are included in the SettingsModal save payload (interval / transient retries persist).
- Light theme: new-assistant modal backdrop opacity reduced to 5%.

## Changed

- Tool display names: manage_note → Notes / 笔记管理; search_history → Search chat history / 搜索聊天记录.

zh.title: 0.14.1 更新内容
highlights: 浅色主题新建助手遮罩更轻
工具显示名更口语：笔记管理、搜索聊天记录
zh.bodyMarkdown:
## 修复

- 设置：SlidingPillTabs 不再调用 scrollIntoView（编辑/自动保存时外层设置面板不再回弹滚动）；设置正文/导航滚动条与聊天区统一为细滚动条样式。
- 设置：Watchdog 字段纳入 SettingsModal 保存载荷（间隔 / 瞬时重试可持久化）。
- 浅色主题：新建助手弹框遮罩透明度降至 5%。

## 变更

- 工具显示名：manage_note → 笔记管理 / Notes；search_history → 搜索聊天记录 / Search chat history。
